reason: The paired-load proposals rank first because the incumbent compiler block shows four separate operand loads in the hot loop, and the local probe confirms paired-load code generation and sample correctness. This is not GEMM performance evidence; several IDs describe essentially the same change, so they are adjacent and should not count as independent experiments. The two output-store proposals also describe the same change and rank next: external implementation evidence and a local probe support testing indirect stores, but neither establishes a gain here. B-panel packing has a plausible locality benefit, with packing cost and L1D capacity as clear risks. The remaining changes have less direct evidence or more implementation complexity. Fresh measurements and correctness checks must decide outcomes; historical noisy scores do not establish causality.
